title: VipPolicyResult
description: vip.policy-result@1: answers about gated-resource rules on OpenVibe.VIP (vip.resource.policy.get, vip.resource.policy.set). GET /api/v1/policies?service=&type=&id=&owner= → { rule }: the owner's active rule for that resource (owner, the creator's usr_ id or network, is required for services; a person defaults to themselves; 404 vip.rule_not_found when there is none); GET /api/v1/policies[?creator=] → { rules }: a creator's active rules, newest first; GET /api/v1/policies/:id → { rule }; POST /api/v1/policies (201) → { rule }; DELETE /api/v1/policies/:id → { rule } (now disabled).
